GameDraft local patch (2026-10-01):
- saveCaptureData options.resourceIds selects captured command references plus
  full frame resource IDs and transitive descriptor/parent dependencies before serialization.
- externalResourceSnapshots omits cached texture mipData; exact bytes belong to RHI sidecars.
- beginFrameCapture resetValidationErrors starts each job with current validation evidence.
- Persistent object descriptors remain available for later captures of live resources.
- HUD display patch (2026-10-02): hide the cumulative dropped estimate; keep FPS, frame times, pause status, and internal frame statistics.
